warnings: The mapping is deliberately partial: it maps BN_NAME to entity.trading_name and leaves business-name registration status, registration/cancellation dates, former state-registration fields, and BN_ABN unmapped because the ontology lacks a safe business-name-specific target or holder/ownership support.

BN_NAME is a source business name and may not be a trading name in every ordinary-language sense, but the documentation explicitly describes it as a name used in relation to one or more businesses; the mapping discloses this subject limitation and makes no legal-name or ownership claim.
The row grain and subject role correctly avoid treating each row as a legal entity. No branch, licence, address, reporting-group, or current/former-name assertion is made.

The publication proxy is appropriately disclosed as an observation timestamp policy rather than a row-change timestamp; the supplied timestamp is future-dated relative to the stated current date, but it is explicitly supplied as publication_proxy and the engine permits that policy. Human review should verify the snapshot metadata in operational use.
The confidence values are provisional judgements, as disclosed. The 0.98 field confidence is high but defensible for a direct, trimmed BN_NAME mapping; it is not evidence of legal-entity linkage.

The discovery sample and validation coverage cannot establish completeness, duplicate behavior, uncommon statuses, malformed dates, or identifier edge cases, but this is a limitation rather than a semantic blocker.
evidence_checked: ASIC dataset summary: snapshot of the Business Names Register; currently registered names and deregistered names for the preceding 12 months.
ASIC Help File p. 7: BN_NAME is a name used, or to be used, in relation to one or more businesses and appears on the Business Names register.

ASIC Help File p. 7-9: BN_STATUS is business-name registration status; BN_REG_DT and BN_CANCEL_DT concern the business name; BN_STATE_NUM and BN_STATE_OF_REG are former-regulator historical fields; BN_ABN may be NULL for suppressed, multiple, or unavailable ABNs.
Raw discovery rows: BN_NAME values, Registered status, dates, blank cancellation/former-state fields, and populated 11-digit-looking ABNs; no holder/legal-name/address/group fields.
Ontology and trusted engine semantics: separate legal/trading concepts, exact provenance, no unsupported constants, and unknown subject role prevents entity linking.

warnings: The mapping is deliberately partial: it emits only BN_NAME as entity.trading_name for rows with BN_STATUS exactly Registered. This is semantically supported as a current business-name claim, not a legal-name, holder, licence, branch, reporting-group, or legal-entity-status claim.

The source documents that BN_NAME is a name used in relation to one or more businesses; calling the target entity.trading_name is acceptable only under the stated unknown/unsupported ownership semantics and should not be read as asserting that the label belongs to a resolved legal entity.
Trimming leading whitespace is a supported normalization and does not erase meaningful documented name content in the supplied evidence, but the raw value remains available through provenance.

BN_ABN is correctly left unmapped: although documented as an ABN, the row does not establish holder/legal-entity ownership, and the source documents suppression, multiple-ABN, and unavailable cases. No unsupported identifier linkage is asserted.

BN_STATUS is correctly used as an exact membership filter rather than mapped to entity.status. BN_REG_DT and BN_CANCEL_DT are correctly excluded because they concern the business name, not necessarily the legal entity.

The dataset is a point-in-time snapshot containing current registrations and deregistered names for the preceding 12 months; cancellation/history coverage is therefore limited. The publication proxy timestamp is an allowed observation-time policy, not row-change time.
No source addresses, service locations, licence numbers, legal names, entity types, reporting groups, ACNs, or renewal date are supplied. The removed BN_RENEW_DT should not be expected or mapped.

The supplied exploratory Python failed with NameError, but raw discovery records, documentation, mapping, and validator evidence were still available; this limits independent exploration only and is not itself a semantic defect.
Confidence values are disclosed as provisional judgements, not measured probabilities.
evidence_checked: ASIC Help File p. 2: snapshot, currently registered business names, and deregistered business names for the preceding 12 months.
ASIC Help File p. 3-4: tab-delimited file and supplied headers/sample records.
ASIC Help File p. 7: REGISTER_NAME and BN_NAME definitions; BN_STATUS definition and Registered/Cancelled values.
ASIC Help File p. 8: BN_REG_DT, BN_CANCEL_DT, former state number and previous state of registration semantics.
ASIC Help File p. 9: BN_ABN semantics, suppression/multiple/unavailable caveats, and April 2025 removal of BN_RENEW_DT.
Discovery records: BN_NAME values, exact Registered statuses, dates, empty cancellation/former-state fields, and 11-digit ABN examples.
Previous mapping: exact Registered filter, trading-name-only emission, explicit unmapped fields and limitations.
Trusted engine semantics: provenance envelope, publication proxy, conditional filters, identifier/linking restrictions, and unknown subject-role handling.
Validation feedback: passed parsing/type validation over 250 records with 221 observations; noted not to be treated as semantic ground truth.
